name: System Admin
description: Full administrative access to System Monitor: manage GPU services configuration, stop/start/restart containers, and delete telemetry records.

name: System Operator
description: Operational access to System Monitor: write telemetry (telemetry collector), soft-unload GPU workloads, and manage GPU service configuration. Cannot delete records or perform hard container controls.

name: System Viewer
description: Read-only access to System Monitor: view host, container, and GPU telemetry. Cannot create, modify, or delete any records.
